pixelMethod.coordinates: Integer original PNG pixels, top-left origin. Landscape raw 2064 x 2752 EXIF 8 maps display(x,y) -> raw(2063-y,x); upright display 2752 x 2064. Portrait orientation absent/1 uses identity mapping. No rotated/resampled output was written.
pixelMethod.profile: All four candidate PNGs declare sRGB 00. Original encoded RGB bytes are treated as sRGB with no ICC conversion or physical-display calibration.
pixelMethod.formula: For each 8-bit channel v, c=v/255; linear=c/12.92 if c<=0.04045, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4. Y=0.2126*Rlinear+0.7152*Glinear+0.0722*Blinear. Contrast=(max(Y1,Y2)+0.05)/(min(Y1,Y2)+0.05), rounded to 3 decimals.
pixelMethod.comparison: Exactly the baseline foreground/proxy coordinates are repeated. New backdrop proxies include the actual fitted material. Foreground artwork is multicolor and composited, so dark/brass/body layers must be interpreted together.
pixelMethod.limits: These are nearby composited proxies, not reconstructed backgrounds beneath opaque glyphs, whole-glyph minima, an image-wide contrast audit or control recognition thresholds. Raw PNG bytes, not resized tool previews, supply the measurements.
